Career Market Analytics with PySpark

Tools: PySpark, Python, Spark SQL, AWS, Quarto, GitHub
Key Work:

Cleaned and transformed large job-posting datasets using Spark DataFrames
Analyzed job demand by NAICS industry and occupation
Explored salary patterns and employment trends
Examined skill requirements across analytics-related roles
Built a Quarto-based website to present findings and recommendations


Average salary comparison across selected major U.S. metro areas.

Top industries by job posting count based on NAICS 2022 classification.

title: About Me
text:
My Background
I have studied and worked across different environments in Japan, China, and the United States, which has given me experience working across cultures, languages, and business settings.
Professionally, I spent more than three years working in manufacturing operations, where I supported data analysis, process improvement, management reporting, and cross-functional problem solving.
These experiences helped me develop an interest in roles where analytical work connects directly to business strategy and operational decisions.

title: About Me
text:
What I Enjoy Working On
I am especially interested in problems that involve:

Turning complex data into clear business insights
Identifying trends and opportunities for improvement
Supporting operational and strategic decisions
Building dashboards and visualizations for decision-makers
Evaluating business scenarios, costs, risks, and investments
Working across functions to solve practical business problems

title: About Me
text:
My Approach
I enjoy combining technical analysis with business context.
For me, analytics is most valuable when the result is understandable, practical, and useful for decision-making.
My goal is not only to build models or dashboards, but to connect analysis with real business questions such as:

What is driving performance?
Where are the biggest risks or opportunities?
Which option creates the most business value?
How can data support a better decision?
